name: sched_yield
description: sched_yield() causes the calling thread to relinquish the CPU. The thread is moved to the end of the queue for its static priority and a new thread gets to run.

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

bugs: sched_yield() is intended for use with real-time scheduling policies (e.g., SCHED_FIFO or SCHED_RR). Use with nondeterministic policies like SCHED_OTHER is unspecified and may indicate a flawed application design. Avoid unnecessary calls to prevent performance degradation due to context switches.
